title: Wayfare Pro Status and Temporary License Acceptance Days: Decision Table
content:
Under the **Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing** product, the Wayfare Pro status a driver holds bears on the temporary license acceptance days, the calendar days from the upload day for which a paper temporary driver's license is accepted as the driver's license on file. The status is the one held on the driver's earnings account under the **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro** product.

**Rule.** A driver whose earnings account holds Wayfare Pro Platinum, Wayfare Pro Diamond or Wayfare Pro Diamond Elite adds 6 days to the temporary license acceptance days; a driver holding Wayfare Pro Silver or Wayfare Pro Gold adds 3 days; a driver holding Wayfare Pro Blue adds none.

| Pro status on the earnings account | Days added |
|---|---|
| Wayfare Pro Diamond Elite | 6 |
| Wayfare Pro Diamond | 6 |
| Wayfare Pro Platinum | 6 |
| Wayfare Pro Gold | 3 |
| Wayfare Pro Silver | 3 |
| Wayfare Pro Blue | 0 |

Here Gold sits with Silver: a Gold driver adds 3 days. The status read is the one the earnings account holds when the days are worked out.
